description:
Anne after being reborn as a winter spirit upon receiving some gifts from Rupee.
Rupee's infectious energy has made her more cheerful and optimistic than ever before.

lines.text: I bought a new notebook. I'll be able to write down all my memories here!
Rupee bought this for me, isn't it pretty? I'm going to wear it every day!
Shopa... holic? I just shout it out like this, right?
What a miracle! I've noted down and made so many precious memories.
The clothes Rupee bought me are so shiny! I feel just like a fairy.
Shopaholic! Rupee said if I keep repeating that slogan, it'll lift my spirits.
Hey, where did you go? I get anxious whenever you're not around.
I'll just flip through my notebook until you come back. I wrote down a bunch of memories with you and Rupee.
This place is so warm, I love it. I want to come here every day.
There are a lot of fun books at the library. I spent the entire day reading.
I get a big kick out of the library. It's full of people's memories.
Let's go make memories together!
Wow, cool! I feel like I could jump and take off flying.
Whoa, it feels like my entire body is glowing!
Weird, it feels like my wings have grown in size.
So this is what a gift is! Rupee said they're a good thing.
Is this for me? Thank you!
A gift? Thank you!
I appreciate you spending so much time with me.
I'm always happy whenever I'm with you.
This notebook contains so many wonderful memories now.
I'll go anywhere, as long as I'm with you.
Huh? Did someone call me?
I need to go to that shiny place, right?
Something's coming!
I need to finish quickly so I can spend time with you.
I have to survive to continue being happy!
So this will become a memory too?
Hmm... I think this is how I did it...?
This is what you call... reloading, right?
Am I doing this right?
Teacher!
Life is ephemeral. Memories are eternal.
It's time for a miracle!
I did it!
Wow!
Exciting!
Ouch!
Uh...
That hurts!
My memories are fading...
Whew, all done! Did everything work out?
